basic_profile.bio: I'm a laid-back student currently attending Cal Poly Pomona, majoring in Computer Science. I enjoy discussing tech trends and am a huge fan of animated shows like Futurama. Most of my downtime is spent either gaming or surfing Reddit for interesting threads. I'm based in California, so I usually browse Reddit late at night. I'm currently single and working part-time as a tech assistant at a local shop.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise mainly revolves around tech and programming. I've been passionate about computers since high school and have been expanding my knowledge through courses at university and online tutorials.
